display.title: Episode 16: The Star Gazer, Chapter 1 (Defective Copy)
display.summary_short: Episode 16 of Uncle Yossi's Tzivos Hashem on the Air, which began the serial The Star Gazer. This copy of the audio is defective and does not contain the program.
display.summary_long: According to the producer's catalog, episode 16 of Tzivos Hashem on the Air began a new serial story, The Star Gazer, continued in episode 17. The file in the archive is defective: it holds only a fragment of about three seconds of the opening greeting, repeated over and over for the full 31 minutes, so none of the actual program can be heard. This record is kept so the episode's place in the series is documented; a good copy should be found and transferred again.

date.note: Weekly sequence: 1 wk after ep 15 (16 Mar 1982), 1 wk before ep 17 (30 Mar 1982); no gap between them. No date cue of its own.

relations.note: 'The Star Gazer' (1982): ep 16 ch. 1 and ep 17 ch. 2 are chapters of the same airing of the serial.

quality.notes: Audio is a ~3 s piece of the greeting looped for 31 minutes; the transcript only repeats 'Well there, child'. Re-download from Drive if a good copy exists.

needs_human_review: Defective source: find a good copy of episode 16.
